generalCriterionList.description: TENDERS FROM JOINT VENTURES ARE NOT ACCEPTABLE.
BIDDERS SHALL NOT BE UNDER A DECLARATION OF INELIGIBILITY FOR CORRUPT AND FRAUDULENT PRACTICES ISSUED BY GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA

TO ENSURE BROWSER COMPATIBILITY OF THE COMPUTER WELL IN ADVANCE TO THE LAST DATE AND TIME FOR RECEIPT OF TENDERS THE DEPARTMENTS SHALL NOT BE RESPONSIBLE FOR NON-ACCESSIBILITY OF KPP PORTAL DUE TO INTERNET CONNECTIVITY ISSUES AND TECHNICAL GLITCHES AT BIDDERS END.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
THE BIDDER SHALL PAY CONTRACT MANAGEMENT MODULE PROCESSING FEES OF 0.025% OF THE CONTRACT VALUE (MIN. RS.500/- & MAX. RS.7500/-) SOON AFTER THE CONTRACT HAS BEEN ISSUED TO THE BIDDER
ALL MATERIALS SHOULD BE IN GOOD QUALITY AS PER SPECIFICATION A QUALITY CERTIFICATE FOR THE SAME SHOULD BE OBTAINED FROM THE CONCERNED AUTHORITY AT THEIR OWN COST.
ACCEPTANCE/CANCELLATION OF THE WORKS ARE RESERVED BY THE UNDERSIGNED WITHOUT ANY REASONS FOR THE SAME

ALL THE SCANNED DOCUMENTS PERTAINING TO BIDDER TO BE UPLOADED SHALL BE ORIGINAL, AND SAME ORIGINALS SHOULD BE PRODUCED TO THE EXECUTIVE ENGINEER (AT THE TIME OF TECHNICAL BID OPENING), WHO RESERVES RIGHT TO VERIFY THE ORIGINAL DOCUMENTS BEFORE APPROVAL.

ALL THE MATERIALS TO BE UTILIZED FOR THE WORK MUST BE TESTED IN PRED LABS, AND QUALITY CONTROL TEST REPORTS MUST BE ENCLOSED WITH THE BILLS. ALL TYPES OF PIPES AND PUMPING MACHINERY WITH ACCESSORIES MUST BE TESTED AT M/S. SGS INDIA LTD, CIPET & AIPS INSTITUTES. THE COST OF ALL QC TEST MUST BE BORNE BY CONTRACTOR.
TO QUALIFY FOR AWARD OF THIS CONTRACT, EACH TENDERER SHOULD GIVE ALL DETAILS AND DOCUMENTS AS PER TECHNICAL AND FINANCIAL BID ATTACHED TO THIS TENDER.
IF ANY DATE IN THE TENDER TIMETABLE IS GOVERNMENT HOLIDAY, NEXT WORKING DATE WILL BE CONSIDERED.
INCOMPLETE/CONDITIONAL TENDERS WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.
THE TENDERER MUST SUBMIT HIS PRESENT ACCURATE POSTAL ADDRESS AND PHONE/ CELL PHONE NUMBER
THE TENDER MAY BE CANCELLED BY EXECUTIVE ENGINEER, RDW&SD, KARWAR AT ANY STAGE WITHOUT ASSIGNING ANY REASON
TENDERERS MUST HAVE VALID PWD REGISTRATION AND MUST SUBMIT PWD REGISTRATION COPY

LIQUID ASSETS AND /OR AVAILABILITY OF CREDIT FACILITIES OF NO LESS THAN RS 8.98 LAKHS (CREDIT LINES/ LETTER OF CREDIT/ CERTIFICATES FROM BANKS FOR MEETING THE FUND REQUIREMENT ETC. (USUALLY, THE EQUIVALENT OF THE ESTIMATED CASH FLOW FOR THREE MONTHS IN THE PEAK CONSTRUCTION PERIOD)

THE RATES OF ITEMS ARE INCLUSIVE OF COST OF MATERIALS, LABOR CHARGES, HOM OF MACHINERY, ALL LEAD AND LIFTS AND ALL OTHER CHARGES TO COMPLETE THE WORK SUCCESSFULLY AS PER SPECIFICATIONS AND AS DIRECTED BY ENGINEER IN CHARGE OF WORK
THE TENDERERS MUST SUBMIT THE SCANNED DOCUMENTS IN PDF/JPEG FORM, NOT IN OTHER FORM.
ANY OBJECTION REGARDING THE TENDER MUST BE SUBMITTED DIRECTLY TO EXECUTIVE ENGINEER NOT IN INWARD
EXECUTIVE ENGINEER RDW&S DIVISION KARWAR HAS AUTHORITY TO ACCEPT OR REJECT ANY TENDER WITHOUT ASSIGNING REASON
FOR INTERPRETATIONS OF CLAUSES, CONDITIONS, SPELLING MISTAKES, ETC., DECISION OF EXECUTIVE ENGINEER, RDW&S DIVISION, KARWAR IS FINAL
CORRIGENDUMS/MODIFICATIONS/CORRECTIONS, IF ANY, WILL BE PUBLISHED IN KPP PORTAL ONLY

THE BIDDER MUST SUBMIT LAST 5 FINANCIAL YEARS (2021-22 TO 2025-26) PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT OBTAINED FROM CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT (CA) AS PER WHICH THE BIDDER SHALL HAVE ACHIEVED IN AT LEAST TWO FINANCIAL YEARS A MINIMUM FINANCIAL TURNOVER (IN ALL CLASSES OF CIVIL ENGINEERING CONSTRUCTION WORKS ONLY) OF RS. 29.92 LAKHS (USUALLY NOT LESS THAN AMOUNT PUT TO TENDER UNDER THIS CONTRACT)

SATISFACTORILY COMPLETED (AT LEAST 50% OF THE CONTRACT VALUE), AS PRIME CONTRACTOR, AT LEAST ONE SIMILAR WORK SUCH AS OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE OF MVS WATER SUPPLY SCHEME OF VALUE NOT LESS THAN RS 14.96 LAKHS IN THE LAST FIVE FINANCIAL YEARS I.E. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)

THE TENDERER SHOULD HAVE EXPERIENCE OF SATISFACTORILY COMPLETING O&M OF ONE MULTI-VILLAGE DRINKING WATER SUPPLY PROJECT FOR A PERIOD OF AT LEAST TWO YEARS. IN THE LAST FIVE FINANCIAL YEARS I.E. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)
ALL CONDITIONS AS PER KW-2 DOCUMENTS

THE CONTRACT IS FOR THE PERIOD OF ONE YEAR AND IT WILL BE CONTINUED WITH 5% INCREASE IN CONTRACT PRICE FOR UP TO 5 YEARS INCLUDING FIRST YEAR ON THE BASIS OF PERFORMANCE OF THE CONTRACTOR TOWARDS OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE OF THE PROPOSED SCHEME
EPF, ESI & LABOUR LICENSE CERTIFICATE

THE CONTRACTOR OWN OR HIRE REQUIRED MACHINERY EQUIPMENT FOR SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF WORK AND TENDERER MUST HAVE FOLLOWING STAFF PATTERN (A) PUMP OPERATORS-02 NOS (B) HELPERS-02 NOS (C) ELECTRICIAN/MECHANIC -01 NOS (D) HELPER CUM WATCHMEN-02 NOS (E) FITTER-01 NOS (F) VALVE MAN-02 NOS (BIO-DATA SHOULD BE ATTACHED)
ELIGIBLE TENDERERS WILL BE QUALIFIED ONLY IF THEIR AVAILABLE TENDER CAPACITY IS MORE THAN THE TOTAL TENDER VALUE. THE AVAILABLE TENDER CAPACITY WILL BE CALCULATED AXNX2.5 -B

itemList.description:
OPERATION AND MAINTAINANCE: 2026-27: Operation and Maintainance of the Scheme as per TOR Which includes Providing Sufficient technical staff valve man, Operators, Electrician and others who are required to run the system in complete manner and providing all materials chemicals required for operation of jackwells/WTP/Pipeline repair works.
(1)   Regular maintenance of civil structure like jackwell/settling tank, Raw water Balancing tank, Pressure filter, Pure water Sump, Pump house MBT/ZBT & all Other Civil structure. The Maintainance Consist of all kinds of repair to damaged structures cleaning & Washing and Painting for civil structures once in a year All the infrastructure Must be Maintained in good working Condition through out the year so as to Ensure Uninterupted water supply to all the habitation through out the year.
(2) Repairs and replacement of damaged pipe line valves etc. if found necessary it includes cost of materials and labour charges and also monitoring of the systems.The Maintainance involves raw water Rising main, Gravity Mains, pure water rising mains, maintaining the required discharge the quantum of water in each pipe.
(3) Operation and Maintainance of Water Treatment plant including dosing of required quantity of Alum, Chlorine and Other required necessary chemicals including replacement of sand/filter media as required as per standard of Established norms from time to time. Maintainance the quality of water as per the guidelines CPHEEO Manual and ISI Specifications including cost of testing of water @ laboratary twice in a month. 
(4) Operation and Maintainace of all kinds of Pumping Machinary Other Mechanical Components of this scheme including Electrical Maintainance Covering all repairs/Replacement of Electaical Cable/Switch Board/ Replacement of burnt parts of Machinary all the Above repair & Maintainance will be carried out as per the Direction of the Engineer-in Charges for Satisfactary functining of the Scheme to Provide designed discharge (LPCD) of Drinking water to all the habitations of the Project villages. 
Note: Helpers Watchman Valve man Elctrician Technical staff made available round the clock for maintainance period @ Jackwell WTP and Pure water sump points (1) The GP or VWSC concerned AEE of the Projects should certify the satisfactory functioning of the scheme and based on this payment will be made to the contractor (2) The contractor should Maintain a Log book on the working of pumping machinery at Jackwell WTP and intermediate sump etc. The payment will be made by Engineer incharges for satisfactory report of every month end. (The G.P Secretary and SO incharge of WSS should give satisfactory report). subject to condition appended in TOR etc complete with all lead and lift charges. Including Loading and Unloading, cost of conveyance of all materials, Labour, Cost of equipments, machineries, Trasporatation etc. complete as per specification and direction of Engineer incharge of the work. FOR THE PERIOD OF ONE YEAR
